Name: Mx. Honorific
Author: Suntooth
Description:
A simple mod to change honorifics to Mx, as well as removing lines that call the player "sir", in most cases. If I've missed anything, let me know!

Need a quick way to ensure the mod was installed correctly? Start a new savefile and talk to Pierre - his introduction dialogue will refer to you as "Mx. [name]".

Manifest.Name: Mx. Honorifics
Manifest.Description: Changes all player honorifics (Mr, Miss, etc) to Mx.
Manifest.Author: Suntooth
